query:
SELECT id, secret AS "blob!" FROM notify_channels
               WHERE secret IS NOT NULL
                 AND ($3::uuid IS NULL OR id > $3)
                 AND CASE WHEN length(secret) >= 3
                     THEN get_byte(secret, 1) * 256 + get_byte(secret, 2) <> $1
                     ELSE false END
               ORDER BY id LIMIT $2
